status: PROPOSED — no routine has been created; the main session asks the user before creating any.
cron_note: cron_ict fields are minute hour day month weekday in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (use CRON_TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). Minutes are off the hour to avoid :00 congestion.
principles: Run after the publisher’s release, not on a fixed fast poll.
Annual series are checked only in their release window.
Daily market data stays on the server scheduler.
Merge jobs that read the same release (NSO monthly + MoF budget; SBV tables + VBMA/Vietcap monthly).
Because nearly every source host is blocked from the sandbox, every agent run budgets web searches; server-side fetches (Render) are preferred where an API exists.

jobs.rule: existing nightly refresh_snapshot
jobs.reason: Prices change every session; already automatic; no agent needed.

jobs.rule: after nso_monthly_report + mof_budget_monthly: 4th of each month (NSO on the 3rd; MoF ~same days)
jobs.reason: CPI and the YTD block change monthly on a fixed date; checking earlier finds nothing, later leaves the page stale. Priority watch: FDI (registered by component + disbursed) and tourism (arrivals by market, outbound, travel services) are in the same NSO/FIA release — add them to every run, no extra trigger needed.

jobs.rule: same run as econ-monthly-nso in Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct
jobs.reason: GDP and investment by owner are quarterly with the monthly report.

jobs.rule: after nso_annual_gdp (4–10 Jan), after NSO yearbook (check 1 Jul and 1 Aug), after NA final-account vote, after WB IDS (mid Dec)
jobs.reason: Annual series cannot change between these windows — polling monthly wastes the search budget.

jobs.rule: after imf_weo (+2 days: 2026-10-15), wb_eap_update (now, Oct-6), adb_ado (Apr/Jul/Sep/Dec), oecd_eo (Jun/Dec), amro
jobs.reason: IMF Oct-2026 WEO (13 Oct) and WB EAP (6 Oct) supersede the Apr/May vintages used in CPI_FC_INST and FINSYS.projections; Economy and Finance must use the same vintage.

jobs.rule: after sbv_credit_total: 5th of each month
jobs.reason: SBV states credit growth at the start of each month; Policy credit_growth_target current text quotes it.

jobs.rule: after sbv_money_tables / sbv_credit_sector (~2-month lag) and VBMA/Vietcap monthly reports: 20th of each month
jobs.reason: M2/deposits and sector tables lag ~2 months; checking on the 20th catches both the SBV tables and the mid-month bond/money-market reports in one run.

jobs.rule: after bank_fs_quarterly (1 Feb/May/Aug/Nov) and sbv_prudential (~15 Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec)
jobs.reason: Bank FS and SBV prudential tables are quarterly with known lags.
Fed upper bound feeds the SBV-vs-Fed gap in the constraints and drivers.
jobs.runner: agent run (or server, see proposal P-4)

jobs.rule: weekly Monday; extra runs on 2026-11-21 (NA session close) and 2026-12-15 (year-end expiries: VAT 8%, fuel tax/duty, fees end 31/12/2026)
jobs.reason: Policy moves are ad hoc and the news list must stay within 3 months; the expiry cliff on 31/12 makes December critical.

jobs.rule: weekly Monday; twice weekly (Mon, Thu) during NA session 17/10–20/11/2026; re-derive stages on 1st of each month (effective dates passing)
jobs.reason: 11 tracked drafts are due for a vote at this session; stage changes are date-driven.

jobs.rule: after nso_population: 2027-01-06 and after the full survey tables (check 2027-07-01)
jobs.reason: Demographics are annual; nothing to update between January and mid-year.

jobs.rule: after nso_grdp: 30th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec (+ provincial 3rd-of-month briefings)
jobs.reason: Provincial GRDP now comes on the 29th of the quarter’s last month (Decree 13/2026).
WDI changes twice a year; ranks are recomputed from the API (blocked here — needs a reachable runner).

jobs.rule: after un_wpp 2027 release (check quarterly in 2027)
jobs.reason: WPP 2026 postponed to 2027.

jobs.rule: after any embed run; and on the 1st of each month check that every "what to watch" date is in the future
jobs.reason: Watch lists are computed, but past-dated items and legacy hard-coded KPI strings need an editor’s eye.

jobs.rule: weekly Monday 07:45, local only (no web): rerun cross-tab checks and the due list; monthly on the 6th with a reachability probe and a few release-calendar confirmations
jobs.reason: Keeps consistency and staleness visible at near-zero web cost.
jobs.runner: agent run (or server, see proposal P-1)

jobs.owner_agent: Economy + Finance + Policy (+ Ed for code)
jobs.rule: one-off, as soon as approved
jobs.reason: Unowned constants show unsourced/extrapolated numbers (FX reserves 2026–29, OMO 4.0%, credit 2025 15.5%, static deposit rates).

jobs.rule: after remittances_hcmc: 25th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct (next 2026-10-25)
jobs.reason: HCMC releases ~3-4 weeks after quarter end (observed 22/07/2026, 23/01/2026); the national total has no regular release, so checking it monthly wastes searches — piggy-back one national query on this run.

jobs.rule: one-shot 2026-10-20 (Q2-2026 overdue), then 20th of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct until the lag is learned
jobs.reason: SBV quarterly BoP is irregular (low-confidence rule); secondary income and BoP FDI are priority-watch inputs. Can share the run with fin-monthly-tables (20th).

jobs.rule: inside research-weekly-audit on Mondays: one search for large FDI registrations / adjustments / withdrawals; writes priority_watch.json news_watch only
jobs.reason: Mega-project news is ad hoc and moves monthly registered totals; Research logs it so Economy's monthly run can explain jumps. No data file changes.

jobs.rule: merge into econ-annual: Jan (HCMC FY, VNAT FY revenue, national statement) and Dec (KNOMAD/WDI)
jobs.reason: Annual remittance/tourism revenue values only change at these windows.

priority_watch_note: 2026-10-06: user standing task — FDI registered vs disbursed, remittances, tourism get special focus. Coverage: monthly via econ-monthly-nso (4th); HCMC remittances via priority-remit-hcmc (25th of quarter-start months); BoP via priority-bop-quarterly; news via research-weekly-audit. All routines are PAUSED (routines.json) until the repo is attached; these are proposals for the main session.
